The Jupiler Pro League stage was set for a compelling encounter between FCV Dender EH and RAAL La Louvière on May 4, 2026 . As both teams took to the pitch, the atmosphere was thick with anticipation for a contest that would be decided by moments of individual brilliance and tactical discipline. Clinical Dominance in the Opening Half The narrative of the match was established early on as the home side showcased remarkable efficiency in front of goal . Following a period of balanced play, FCV Dender EH broke the deadlock in the 31st minute when Pape Moussa Fall clinicaly finished to give his side the lead. The momentum stayed firmly with the hosts, and just three minutes later, Desmond Acquah turned provider, setting up Mohamed Berte to double the advantage and leave the RAAL La Louvière defense reeling. Despite an early setback that saw Alireza Jahanbakhsh forced off due to injury, his replacement, Bruny Nsimba , made an immediate impact. In the 44th minute, Dender were awarded a penalty, and Nsimba stepped up to the spot, calmly converting to ensure a three-goal cushion heading into the break. It was a masterclass in clinical football that left the visitors with a mountain to climb in the second half . Friction and Late Red Card Drama The restart brought a wave of tactical changes as both managers turned to their benches. RAAL La Louvière introduced fresh legs in Majeed Ashimeru and Jerry Afriyie , while Dender brought on Ragnar Oratmangoen . The increased physicality of the game led to several cautions, with Nachon Nsingi and Oratmangoen both entering the referee’s book as the battle in midfield intensified. Despite the numerous substitutions and tactical shifts, the scoreline remained static through much of the half. However, the closing minutes provided one final twist of drama. In the 88th minute, Bo De Kerf was shown a straight red card, sparking heavy protests from his teammates and leaving Dender to navigate the final moments with ten men. The home side managed to weather the late pressure during four minutes of stoppage time, securing a significant victory in a sports showcase that combined first-half flair with second-half resilience.
